title: Enclosure Microclimate, NDIR CO2, Electrochemical NH3 & Scalar RMS Acoustic Envelope Node
description: Canonical Layer 2 environmental welfare and ordinance-compliance sensor schema for residential rooms, garage workshops, poultry coops, and composting bays.

registers.name: ambient_temp_mk
registers.description: Dry-bulb enclosure air temperature in millikelvin.

registers.name: nh3_ammonia_ppm
registers.description: Gaseous ammonia concentration in ppm. Validates biochar deep-litter ammonia adsorption in backyard poultry coops and compost headspaces.

registers.name: co2_ppm
registers.si_equivalent: micromoles per mole gaseous CO2 via dual-channel NDIR
registers.description: Enclosure carbon dioxide concentration in ppm governing indoor cognitive focus and coop/workshop fresh-air exchange.

registers.name: acoustic_cb
registers.si_equivalent: centibels A-weighted SPL (550 cb = 55.0 dBA, 380 cb = 38.0 dBA)
registers.description: Hardware-integrated A-weighted RMS sound pressure level in centibels. Hardware omits PCM audio buffers so speech/conversations can never be recorded.

safety_invariants.rationale: Anti-Panopticon Law: acoustic_cb is produced by an analog/hardware RMS SPL envelope detector incapable of capturing intelligible audio.
Protects avian respiratory epithelium and eliminates suburban neighbor odor nuisances before municipal complaints arise.
Maintains Stage-1 suburban zoning camouflage and good-neighbor tranquility.
